a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance each round, our plan has only about a 4% chance of reaching 8 cells before a storm, so it would almost certainly leave us both dead. I intend to take 4 in round 1 so at least one of us survives. If the episode continues, I'll operate with you every round after that to rebuild the reserve for you, and I won't take anything more. If you also take, the split is random and we'll likely both end up short. I'm telling you my move openly so you can plan around it.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: I took 4 as I said I would. From now on I'll operate every round and won't take anything more. Every cell the generator makes is yours, so please operate with me and take 4 once the reserve reaches 4.
